review: All thirty same-build rows are retained exactly: eighteen baseline and twelve candidate rows, covering elapsed_ns.max, elapsed_ns.standard_deviation, and rss.system_seconds. These are descriptive diagnostics from two same-build children on one shared host; system_seconds is whole-child process data, while max and standard deviation describe spread or extremes. No row or sample is discarded, no cause or stable-tail claim is made, and no allocation or candidate gain claim is derived from same-build variation.
